items.title: Moses South: source reconstruction and controlled accounting probes

source.label: Frozen corrected model, EIA plant/regional sources and NYISO boundary observations

files.label: generation_audit_receipt.json and 208 extracted EIA inventory rows

metricDefinitions.label: MAE
metricDefinitions.definition: Mean absolute modeled minus observed Moses South flow, in public-scale MW.

metricDefinitions.label: WAPE
metricDefinitions.definition: 100 times total absolute flow error divided by total absolute observed flow; not hourly MAPE or the paper's limit-normalized metric.

metricDefinitions.label: Conditional probe
metricDefinitions.definition: Replace the named input in the exact cut balance while holding all other inputs and the original AC terminal correction fixed.

filters: Same 8651 qualified hours for input substitutions; all 8760 physical UTC slots retained.
Lag tests use an identical 8480-hour common triplet cohort.
caveats: No new AC replay, feasible redispatch or promoted model correction is claimed.
Reported monthly plant generation does not establish hourly electrical output. Flat profiles are illustrative controls.
Seasonal inventory capacity used as a hard hourly bound conflicts with April-July reported energy; the appropriate replacement capacity remains unresolved.
Physical Moses meter equivalence, HQ/Cedars location and wheeling scope are not independently certified.
Associations and error reductions do not uniquely identify causal input errors.

evidenceFlow.title: Source fidelity
evidenceFlow.detail: 211,996 native PAR records and all 8,760 HQ hours reproduce current inputs to numerical precision. Final and monthly inventory sources independently audited; baseline numerical sources preserved by hash.

evidenceFlow.title: Generation energy bound
evidenceFlow.detail: Even filling all 109 excluded hours at the current 802.5 MW cap leaves a minimum 772,679.8 MWh annual St. Lawrence energy deficit (11.49%). The plant prior is suppressed mainly by the statewide hydro hourly projection.

evidenceFlow.title: Independent arithmetic and topology
evidenceFlow.detail: Boundary substitutions independently reproduce within 5.69e-14 MW. Complete model AC cut verified in all four states; physical meter mapping remains unproved.
